summary: INGInious is a self-hosted grading platform designed to run and test student code automatically. It uses containerisation to execute untrusted submissions in a secure environment and provides feedback based on predefined test cases. The project falls under learning and courses tooling for educational institutions.
goodFor: It is a practical fit for educators and administrators managing programming courses who need an automated way to grade coding assignments securely.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence means any modifications you network must be made freely available, and the moderate maintenance activity suggests you should audit the codebase before relying on it for production exams.
deployNotes: Because the application relies on Docker to execute student code, you will typically need to configure appropriate container permissions and persistent storage for submissions. A standard reverse proxy is usually required to handle TLS termination in front of the web interface.
